summary: Iteration 16 tested bypass approval and service-based reminder routing through the public URL. Backend pytest: 3 passed, 1 failed (75%). Partner approval correctly completes every checklist item and persists approval metadata; staff receives 403; reminder config GET/PATCH persists; login/dashboard and checklist toggle regressions pass. However, AML routing is additive rather than exclusive: the designated staff sees the reminder, but the original assignee also sees it and the response still labels the original assignee. Partner/staff desktop UI flows pass. Reminder Routing is severely off-canvas on 390px mobile.

critical.issue: AML routing does not always route reminders exclusively to the configured designated staff. Reproduction: configure Fazil, create an AML task assigned to Subin, then fetch reminders as both users. Fazil receives it, but Subin also receives it and Fazil's reminder payload says assigned_to='Subin'. This contradicts the requirement that AML reminders always go to fixed designated staff.

ui_bugs.issue: At 390px, the Settings content is translated off the left side of the viewport (settings x=-361; AML select x=-340; first mapping row x=-340 and width=414). The tab remains visible while the actual configuration controls are effectively unusable.

issues: Mobile content is off-canvas despite document scrollWidth equaling viewport width, so users cannot recover it by horizontal scrolling.
Audit mapping selects lack data-testid attributes; each per-client select should have a stable identifier.
Desktop audit mapping is a long undifferentiated list; consider search/grouping or a bounded scroll region for larger client sets.

action_items: Change GET /api/reminders staff task routing to override ordinary assignment for AML tasks: only aml_designated_staff should receive an AML reminder, and the returned assigned_to field should identify the designated staff.
Fix the mobile Settings layout/off-canvas transform and make Reminder Routing controls fit within the viewport.
Add data-testid to each audit mapping select, for example audit-map-select-{client_id}.
After fixes, rerun the iteration 16 API suite plus partner/staff and 390px UI flows.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:2358 always starts the staff query with assigned_to=user_email and only appends service-routing conditions. This union cannot implement 'always/fixed' routing; excluded service modules must be removed from the ordinary assignment branch or effective assignee routing must be computed first.
The reminder response at server.py:2384 renders the stored original assigned_to_name rather than the effective route, creating misleading ownership even for the designated recipient.
server.py:1424 redefines imported require_partner (ruff F811). Remove the duplicate to avoid route behavior depending on declaration order.
server.py shutdown references undefined client at line 3314 (ruff F821); the Mongo client is encapsulated in core.py.
server.py (3315 lines) and Settings.js (over 1000 lines) exceed the 700-line maintainability threshold; split into routers/services and per-tab components.

success_rate.frontend: 87.5% (7/8 exercised checks; mobile Reminder Routing failed)

seed_data_creation: Created disposable TEST_iter16 AML engagements and AML routing tasks. Engagements were archived as Deleted and tasks marked Completed. Reminder configuration was restored by fixture after each module run; final AML staff remains Fazil as originally configured.
test_credentials: Partner and staff credentials were read from /app/memory/test_credentials.md.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The final pytest intentionally expects exclusive AML routing and fails reproducibly. Approval, role protection, config persistence, partner Quick Approve visibility/hiding, checklist toggle, staff button absence, staff Settings restriction, login/dashboard, and desktop config save passed. Re-run pytest and specifically inspect mobile element geometry after fixes.
rca_of_the_issue: Backend RCA: the staff query is built as $or=[assigned_to=current user, AML service when current user is designated, audit mappings]. That additive union grants the designated staff extra visibility but never suppresses the original assignee. The payload then reports the stored assignee. Mobile RCA: Settings content is positioned about 361px left of the viewport while body overflow is clipped, leaving controls unreachable.
